title: Wireless Transmitter

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Transmits an electric signal without wires to a Receiver

body:
"Wirelessly sends the inputted signal to a receiver depending on the assigned keyphrase"


The Wireless Transmitter is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It outputs a electric signal depending on what is inputted into it through a wire and sends it to a Wireless Receiver based on its keyphrase.

Simply said bluetooth electricity transmitter.
